title: Holidays in Brazil and Mexico
text:
Many countries have special holidays. In Brazil, people celebrate Carnival in February. They wear colorful costumes and dance in the streets. Carnival is a very loud and fun time.

In Mexico, families celebrate the Day of the Dead in November. They make special food and put flowers on family graves. They remember family members who died. Many people think it is a beautiful holiday.
